Name: date_introduced
Description: The year and month of the most recent occurrence of the postcode’s date of introduction in the format YYYY-MM

Name: date_terminated
Description: If present - the year and month of the most recent occurrence of the postcode’s date of termination in the format YYYY-MM - otherwise NA

Name: is_active
Description: TRUE if the postcode is currently active/live or FALSE if it has been terminated (in which case date_terminated will not be NA)

Name: la_code
Description: Office for National Statistics (ONS) code of the Local Authority that the postcode lies within

Name: la_name
Description: Name of the Local Authority that the postcode lies within

Name: locality
Description: Trafford Council custom defined area (aligned to ward boundaries) that the postcode lies within (trafford_postcodes.csv only)

Name: ward_code
Description: Office for National Statistics (ONS) code of the electoral ward that the postcode lies within

Name: ward_name
Description: Name of the the electoral ward that the postcode lies within

Name: msoa_code
Description: Office for National Statistics (ONS) code of the Middle-layer Super Output Area that the postcode lies within

Name: msoa_hcl_name
Description: Local area recognisable name assigned by the House of Commons Library of the Middle-layer Super Output Area that the postcode lies within (https://houseofcommonslibrary.github.io/msoanames/)

Name: lsoa_code
Description: Office for National Statistics (ONS) code of the Lower-layer Super Output Area that the postcode lies within

Name: lsoa_name
Description: Schematic name of the Lower-layer Super Output Area that the postcode lies within

Name: oa_code
Description: Office for National Statistics (ONS) code of the Output Area that the postcode lies within

Name: lon
Description: Longitude coordinate of the centroid of the postcode in WGS84 projection

Name: lat
Description: Latitude coordinate of the centroid of the postcode in WGS84 projection
